original_test_intent: Measure each NVIDIA GPU core temperature under a declared operating and ambient condition and compare it with the approved contextual limit.
original_method: Capture UUID/BDF, driver/tool, ambient/inlet sensor, fan/cooling and idle/named-workload state; run the exact temperature.gpu CSV query at the approved time/window; retain units, timestamps, N/A/errors and all devices; compare only with the supplied per-condition thermal policy.
manual_activity: Thermal owner defines the applicable ambient/load condition and limit; the agent can collect, correlate and compare sensor readings.
required_inputs: Approved temperature ceiling/range and sampling instant/window
safety_requirements: Do not alter fan control, clocks, power or workload
No automatic retry or log clearing

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field is correct, but a context-free instant cannot establish expected thermal behavior and its SSH transport is rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the literal temperature.gpu query with UUID, timestamp, ambient/inlet, workload and cooling context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: temperature.gpu CSV and all-GPU scope are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-UUID temperature table annotated with ambient, load, fan/cooling state and approved limit.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the physical conditions required to interpret a temperature.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents a numerically plausible reading from masking an unsuitable ambient or cooling state.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A single sensor sample does not characterize transient hot spots or full stress behavior.

project_override_considerations: Project thermal limits must identify ambient/load assumptions and whether instant or steady-state evidence is required.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Command and criterion consistently address GPU temperature; expected is an omitted project threshold, not a contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Sensor collection is safe; missing contextual limit only defers the formal verdict.

review_improvement: Makes every temperature attributable to a GPU and its physical operating condition instead of judging an isolated number.
independent_technical_reasoning: Temperature is a response to ambient, cooling and load, so the same value can be acceptable in one condition and suspicious in another. Those contextual inputs and the sensor value are machine-readable; the case remains fully automatable once the policy is supplied.
